requirement: Create a susceptibility result for a pathogen: reject unknown or soft-deleted pathogens and antibiotics, enforce one antibiogram per pathogen and MIC category, map the command, link the tested antibiotics, and persist the result.

preconditions.text: A live pathogen exists for the requested pathogen ID
Every requested antibiotic exists and is not soft-deleted
No live antibiogram exists for the pathogen and MIC pair
A live antibiogram already exists for the pathogen and MIC pair
A soft-deleted antibiogram exists for the pathogen and MIC pair

inputs.text: Single antibiotic and MIC Susceptible (lowest enum member)
Single antibiotic and MIC Resistant (highest enum member)
Three antibiotics from different groups and MIC Intermediate
Two beta-lactams sharing the same group lineage
Unknown pathogen ID and one valid antibiotic
Soft-deleted pathogen ID and one valid antibiotic
One valid and one unknown antibiotic ID
Two unknown antibiotic IDs and no valid antibiotic
Same pathogen and MIC as an existing live antibiogram
Same pathogen with a different MIC category
Different pathogen with the same MIC category
Same pathogen and MIC as a soft-deleted antibiogram

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new antibiogram ID
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Pathogen not found' error
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Not all antibiotic exist' error
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation and no persisted antibiogram

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every failure is returned as a failed Result
